Product Tip:

Learn to say “No, Because...”

Not “we’ll put it on the backlog”.

#prodmgmt #ux #design #agile

Imagine if *everyone* in your org, even for day, could...

- own a support ticket
- deploy something into prod
- listen in on sales calls
- watch usability tests
- visit a customer
- onboard a new employee
- go to lunch with random teammates

Imagine the power of that #orgdesign

Key metric ...

Elephant time.

The cumulative amount of time spent across the org talking 1:1 or in small groups about the elephant in the room, without taking some sort of action.

Lower that.
#orgdesign #leadership #management #sensemaking
